assets.prompt: Author four original hovercraft with silhouettes that stay distinguishable at racing distance, each built by lofting authored cross-sections rather than assembling primitives. PlayerSkiff: a broad canard racer whose hull is lofted from nine hard-chined sections, with a ribbed glass canopy seated in a deck recess, a raised vented engine deck, shoulder intake scoops, swept canards rooted inside the hull and carrying emissive leading edges and mid-span nacelles, underslung ride plates with underglow, a dorsal stabiliser, and twin ducted thrusters built as surfaces of revolution with lipped shells, inner burner rings and centre hubs. RivalLance: a long narrow needle with forward-swept wings, ventral skids, a tall single fin and one oversized duct. RivalDelta: a broad flat delta planform with emissive leading-edge root extensions, outboard fins and three small ducts in a row. RivalHauler: a heavy catamaran of two parallel hulls joined by a bridge deck and nose beam, with four ducts and twin fins. Every craft shares one eight-material palette named SKY_HullPlate, SKY_HullTrim, SKY_Canopy, SKY_Graphite, SKY_LiveryBase, SKY_RailCyan, SKY_RailMagenta and SKY_RailAmber, so the runtime can retint livery surfaces per rival by material name. Noses point toward Blender +Y so they export to Three.js -Z forward; origins sit at the centre of mass on the ride plane. Bevel modifiers are baked on export. Named roots PlayerSkiff, RivalLance, RivalDelta and RivalHauler are exported as selected roots only to GLB with no UVs, no vertex colours, no textures, no animations and no compression.
assets.purpose: Player and rival hovercraft silhouettes for the four-craft Skyweave race grid

assets.prompt: Author the suspended-ribbon circuit kit and the drowned-city skyline that frames it, all from swept box sections, lofted profiles and surfaces of revolution. Deck-mounted parts clamp the ribbon rather than straddling the void, and they come in two families. Portals - GateArch, StartGantry and CanopyTruss - span the road and are authored against a 9.8 metre half-width reference deck, so the runtime seats them by scaling that reference onto the local deck width; where the portal is tall, an under-deck yoke with diagonal stays closes the ring beneath the road. Edge clamps - BranchPylon - sit beside the deck at a fixed size and bolt on with a plate that reaches back inboard over the road, so they are placed relative to the deck edge and never rescaled. GateArch: a 29 metre checkpoint portal with a tapered outer arch, an emissive inner ring, radial bracing between the two arches, a lit tie beam, chunky footings and angled banner blades; its origin sits on the ribbon deck centre so it drops straight onto a track sample. StartGantry: the start and finish portal, deliberately half again as tall and wide as a checkpoint so the two can never be confused - a lattice column of paired fore and aft members on each deck edge with rib detail and lit inner-face strips, twin parabolic upper and lower chords tied by a zig-zag web, a lit amber tie beam with timing pods and cyan lenses facing the oncoming grid, amber deck kerbs, an under-deck yoke on four stays, lamp stacks flanking the crown, five downlights washing the line, and above it all a twelve by three chequered banner board in an emissive amber frame with the chequer carried on both faces. BranchPylon: a deck-edge clamp for signposting a fork - a bolted deck plate with amber edge lips, an under-deck hook that reaches back beneath the road, a mast leaning inboard on a back stay and knee braces, and a head board carrying two large chevrons and an inboard cyan strip; the chevrons point toward local +X on BOTH faces and every member that must reach the road runs toward local -X, so one asset signposts either fork under a plain yaw of zero or pi. RibbonAnchor: the suspension spine that hangs beneath the deck, with outrigger arms, diagonal stays, tip pods and a ballast bulb, so the ribbon reads as carried rather than floating. CanopyTruss: a 23 metre overhead gantry that clamps the ribbon - slim paired legs on the deck edges with cross ties and diagonals, arched upper and lower chords over a zig-zag web, cyan deck kerbs, an under-deck yoke, and cyan route lamps hung from the lower chord over the road the ribbon threads. HazardBollard: a small deck hazard with a flared skirt, an emissive warning band and three base fins. TowerBlock_A, TowerBlock_B and TowerBlock_C: three distinct megastructures for instanced skyline placement, respectively a 172 metre tapered slab spire with setbacks, banded window strips, a lit crown and a mast beacon; an 80 metre stepped ziggurat with amber bands, a roof deck, flanking buttresses and a severed skybridge reaching out over the flood; and a 119 metre cluster of three flooded silos of differing heights tied by service decks, ringed with light bands and capped with lit heads. Towers carry their origin at the base. All parts share the SKY_ material palette. Named roots GateArch, StartGantry, BranchPylon, RibbonAnchor, CanopyTruss, HazardBollard, TowerBlock_A, TowerBlock_B and TowerBlock_C are exported as selected roots only to GLB with no UVs, no vertex colours, no textures, no animations and no compression.
assets.purpose: The start and finish portal, checkpoint portals, fork signposts, ribbon suspension structure, route framing, deck hazards and instanced skyline landmarks
